Name: Golden Piggy Buffs
Author: CrypticR3D
Description:
[b]Golden Piggy Buffs[/b] adds a bit of risk and reward to the Golden Piggy Bank added in Stardew Valley Expanded by granting daily randomized buffs — and occasionally curses.

Each day, the piggy bank can bestow temporary effects, with a small chance of a rare full-day blessing or curse that lasts until you sleep.

Check the pinned comment for the full list.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Daily random buffs or debuffs
[*] Custom positive and negative buffs
[*]Vanilla Stardew Valley buffs included alongside custom ones
[*] Luck-based influence on outcomes
[*] Fully configurable via config.json
[*] Safe for multiplayer
[*]Fully localized (i18n support)
[/list]
[b]How it Works[/b]
[list]
[*] The Golden Piggy Bank can only be used once per day
[*] Buff outcomes are rolled based on configurable chances
[*] Effects automatically reset the next day
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*] Install SMAPI
[*] Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*] Run the game once to generate config.json
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] SMAPI required
[*] Stardew Valley Expanded required
[/list]
Made for my wonderful fiancé <3
